name: Cupboard and almirah key duplication
description: Duplicate keys for compatible cupboards, almirahs, drawers and cabinets. Bring your original key so we can match the key profile and confirm the correct blank, cutting requirements and quote.

name: Cupboard and cabinet lock replacement
description: Replacement of compatible cupboard, wardrobe and cabinet locks. Share the existing lock, door or drawer thickness and fitting details so we can check suitable parts and quote for the lock and installation.

name: Door lock cylinder replacement
description: Replacement cylinders for compatible home, office and shop door locks. We check the cylinder size, fitting and supplied keys before quoting for the part and installation. Shop and on-site service are available.
